status: Storyboarding contribution to requested wastewater cutaway; recommendations, not implemented scenery
priority: Use current action-redesign direction. Older zone bounds are orientation only; its ordinary-wave finale does not supersede the required Clogfather.
approved_direction: Large wastewater pipe cutaway below the playable floor, near the bottom of the view.
Visible flowing water carries occasional recognizable improperly flushed objects.
Toward the Clogfather, water level DECREASES while deposited debris INCREASES.
At the boss, no flowing water; grease, oil and disgusting debris completely clog the pipe.
Environmental storytelling only; no new damage, pickups, collision, drainage puzzle or dialogue.
story_read: The player follows the worsening condition of one continuous piece of infrastructure until the accumulated waste explains the boss’s setting. The objects provide occasional discoveries during quieter moments; the pipe should read even when the player ignores individual jokes.

zones.water: Highest visible fill in this progression; clear sustained lateral movement.
zones.debris: Sparse passing toilet paper and one conspicuously inappropriate object, such as a sock. Minimal deposits.
zones.intent: Establish a functioning flow and an easily readable cross-section immediately.

zones.water: Slightly lower surface; still visibly flowing.
zones.debris: Occasional wipes and cotton swabs catch at joints; other items continue past.
zones.intent: First distinction between floating debris and material left behind.

zones.water: Lower again; more exposed pipe interior.
zones.debris: Small grease shelves with wipes snagged on them; fewer objects pass without catching.
zones.intent: Make the change noticeable without a sign explaining it.

zones.water: Shallow moving ribbon between stationary deposits.
zones.debris: Larger compacted clumps, fabric strips and a partly buried rubber duck.
zones.intent: The same familiar objects now disappear into a growing mass.

zones.water: A thin, sluggish trickle; any isolated puddles remain below earlier waterlines.
zones.debris: Grease and tangled fabric nearly bridge the bore. Allow a quiet stretch near the checkpoint to read it.
zones.intent: Prepare the final blockage without showing a second boss.

zones.water: Moving ribbon dwindles to nothing before a fully packed terminal section; no flow through the clog.
zones.debris: Complete obstruction: greasy solid mass, dark oily staining, wipes, roots and trapped rubbish.
zones.intent: Visually lead toward the foreground Clogfather while preserving only one visible boss.

debris_palette.frequent: Small paper fragments, wipes, cotton swabs, hair and fabric strips; simplify at gameplay size.
debris_palette.rare_optional_gag: A laminated DO NOT FLUSH sign drifting past; only if readable without enlarging or distracting from play.
debris_palette.restraint: One distinctive accent at a time, irregularly spaced. Do not pack every view with jokes. No plot clues, new creature eggs, bodies, clone remains or portal hints.

continuity_and_readability: Keep the cutaway consistently below the solid floor and distinguish its rim from walkable platforms. It is not an accessible lower route.
Use consistent pipe diameter/joints and fixed deposits across adjacent views. Debris flow may move while the camera stops.
Suggested lateral drift follows forward level travel, slowing toward obstruction. This is visual direction, not a hydraulic simulation.
Do not replace Sean’s explicitly falling waterline with upstream flooding, rising backed-up water or a waterfall into the arena.
Water height and deposit amount are separate cues: the flowing channel shrinks while solids occupy more of the pipe. Do not paint an oily layer as a rising liquid surface.
Keep below-floor motion lower contrast than heroes, enemies, shots and hazards; no flashy pickup-like glows on debris.

No faces, eyes, breathing or boss-shaped silhouette in the pipe while the foreground Clogfather is visible. The terminal clog is scenery or physically continuous with the single boss, never a duplicate creature.
Maintain progression by world location, including backtracking; do not randomly reset fill levels per view.
Early trial should establish only the early state; do not compress the entire boss buildup into the faster opening slice.
Boss defeat does not automatically restore flow, reveal a portal or repair plumbing. Any aftermath change needs separate approval.
handoff_boundary: Art owns assets; Level Design/Engineering own exact placement, dimensions, rendering and integration. Marketing collects contributions. No magazine regeneration or game launch requested here. No other agents’ files edited.
